name: newsmonger
description: Topic-based news tracker: enter topics, and on a configurable interval the app asks Claude (with web search) for new developments, deduplicating against previously seen stories.
author: Small Tale Inc.

scripts.dev: npm run build:client:dev && node --import tsx/esm src/cli.ts
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:client:dev && node --import tsx/esm src/cli.ts --no-open --strict-port
scripts.build:client: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist/client',{recursive:true})" && node -e "for (const f of ['favicon.svg','logo-full-bleed.svg','wordmark-light.svg','wordmark-dark.svg']) require('fs').copyFileSync('assets/'+f,'dist/client/'+f)" && npx esbuild src/client/app.tsx --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/client/app.global.js --target=es2020 --sourcemap --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=kerfjs --define:__KERF_DEV__=false && npx sass src/client/styles.scss dist/client/styles.css --style compressed --no-source-map
scripts.demo:capture: npm run build:client && node --import tsx/esm scripts/demo/capture-demo.ts
scripts.demo:stills: npm run build:client && node --import tsx/esm scripts/demo/capture-stills.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run build:client
scripts.build:client:dev: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist/client',{recursive:true})" && node -e "for (const f of ['favicon.svg','logo-full-bleed.svg','wordmark-light.svg','wordmark-dark.svg']) require('fs').copyFileSync('assets/'+f,'dist/client/'+f)" && npx esbuild src/client/app.tsx --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/client/app.global.js --target=es2020 --sourcemap --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=kerfjs --define:__KERF_DEV__=true && npx sass src/client/styles.scss dist/client/styles.css --style compressed --no-source-map
